verses.22:45: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةࣱ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئۡرࣲ مُّعَطَّلَةࣲ وَقَصۡرࣲ مَّشِيدٍ

meaning: The root عطل (ETl) primarily describes a woman without ornaments. It extends to being destitute of anything, like property or discipline.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
